answer: Every claim climbs the timber of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the kernel re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. By the knoll of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a dense architectural vocabulary, precise comma splices register, it stays short.
